Service category: Office furnishing rental (Tiverton Office Rentals)
Rating: 4 out of 5
Rental period: 9 weeks
Account type: Business (verified)
Posted: March 14
Nothing I read before booking told me where the limits of this arrangement lie, so I am setting them out here.
Our lease ended nine weeks before the new floor was ready, and buying desks we would then store would have cost more than renting. We took 24 pieces. Delivery staff removed the protective covers on arrival.
The desks and seating were sound. The three storage cabinets, though, were too shallow to hold our files upright. An exchange must be requested while at least fourteen days of the term remain, and we were inside that window, so I asked for deeper units. They arrived four days later rather than the next business day. I claimed nothing off the invoice and booked a second short rental in February.
The total came to $2,150, which our relocation budget covered easily, though delivery and pickup are billed separately and the rate list does not say so.
In my view, then, this kind of rental works well for short projects that need standard desks and seating, but it is a poor fit for teams with unusual storage needs or for terms of under three weeks.

Oakbourne Cleaning Services
Home | Services | Book a Visit | Contact
After-Hours Cleaning
Our after-hours service cleans the carpets and floors of shops and small offices while they are closed, so your business is never disturbed. To book a visit, send us a request at least seven days before the date you would like. In it, list each area to be treated, such as the sales floor, staff room, or offices, and name anything in each area that the crew must leave untouched.
Your request must also name one of our three visit times. Because each time comes with its own access arrangement, please choose the one that matches how your premises can be opened and locked.
6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. — a member of your staff stays on the premises throughout
9:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m. — a keyholder lets the crew in and returns at the end of the visit to lock up
4:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. — a set of keys is left at our office one business day beforehand
Finally, describe the entrance the crew will use, since it sets the arrival allowance, which is the time we set aside before work begins. A ground-floor door with parking beside it needs 15 minutes, while a door reached by stairs only, or one with parking more than 100 yards away, needs 45 minutes.
A few conditions apply to every booking. Our crews bring their own machines and water, so nothing needs to be supplied at the premises. After a visit, treated carpet must not be walked on for six hours. If your plans change, a booked date may be changed once, with three business days' notice.
----------------------
The late evening slot suited us
Rating: 5 out of 5 — service used: after-hours carpet cleaning
Colin Radcliffe, owner of a toy shop, Norbury district
Our shop closes at eight, and I did not want machines running around customers, so I chose the later evening time. I let the crew in myself at nine and came back at 12:30 to lock up after them. Our unit sits above a bakery and has no elevator, so the crew carried every machine up two flights from the street, and work on the carpet still began before ten.
They worked around the display shelves with real care, and nothing was marked. That is not the main reason we changed suppliers, though. The company we used last year told us to clear the floor ourselves before each visit, which kept two of my staff late the night before. This crew moves the furniture out and puts it back as part of the job.
Would book again: Yes

To: All staff who claim work travel costs
From: Harriet Vance
Date: August 24
Subject: Entering your own travel costs
Attached: Staff Travel Payment Rates, Version 3
Dear colleagues,
From September 1, travel costs are entered by the traveler, and paper claim forms are no longer accepted.
Three steps apply. First, enter each journey on a separate line with its date, the way you traveled and the distance covered. Second, ask your supervisor to mark the line as agreed. Nothing is printed for signature, and no paper reaches this office. Third, use the attached sheet for the amount payable and for the kinds of travel that need a receipt.
A line is included in the following month's payment only if it is complete — entered, agreed and carrying any receipt required — by the 25th of the month. Payments are made in the second week of each month.
Questions to the extension below.
Harriet Vance
Employee Payments Office

Staff Travel Payment Rates — Version 3, in force from September 1
Travel category | Payment basis | Amount payable | Receipt required |
Own car, self-driven | Per mile | 32 cents* | No |
Bicycle | Per mile | 12 cents | No |
Train or scheduled bus | Per journey | Ticket price | Yes |
Taxi | Per journey | Meter fare** | Yes |
* A journey longer than 50 miles is paid at 38 cents a mile for its whole distance.
** Payable only where this office agreed to the taxi beforehand. Without that agreement, only the train or bus amount is paid.
